subject: Very quiet stretches: Vesper hardly being pinged
body: [From research interview 3 Sep, logged by Dispatch PM; draft D-01, urgent] Stretches where Vesper's phone just sits there and he is home all week. Ping data: 86 pings before 4.2, 17 after. Starved-responder pattern; see routing fix proposal.

subject: Ping gone before Vesper can reach the phone
body: [From research interview 3 Sep, logged by Dispatch PM; draft D-02, high] By the time he gets to the phone the callout has gone to somebody else; happening more than it used to. Consistent with the 60s ping wait in 4.2. Related: 3043.

subject: Console text too small to read at a glance
body: [From research interview 3 Sep, logged by Dispatch PM; draft D-03] Uses the console standing up and cannot tell if something changed without leaning in. Related: 3013, 3142.

subject: Tell the handler when a callout comes in for her responder
body: [From research interview 3 Sep, logged by Dispatch PM; draft D-04] Would like her own notification when a callout comes in for Vesper, rather than hearing his phone through the ceiling. Input for the Handler Phone App brief.

subject: Meteor Mite almost no callouts while The Gale is overloaded
body: [From research interview 4 Sep, logged by Dispatch PM; draft D-05, urgent] Same area (Eastgate): Meteor Mite quiet all week, The Gale nonstop. Ping data: Meteor Mite 70 before 4.2, 14 after; The Gale 82 to 69. Starved-responder pattern; see routing fix proposal.

subject: Dark mode for the console
body: [From research interview 4 Sep, logged by Dispatch PM; draft D-06] Works nights on three screens; console is a wall of white light. Top request. Related: 3018, 3029, 3105, 3117.

subject: Different alert sound per responder
body: [From research interview 4 Sep, logged by Dispatch PM; draft D-07] Both responders make the same sound, so Kip has to look to see which one. Related: 3031, 3127.

subject: Callout moved on while Captain Vantage was suiting up (again)
body: [From research interview 2 Sep, logged by Dispatch PM; draft D-08, high] Around 19 Aug a callout went to someone else mid-suit-up; learned of it from Vantage, not the console. Asks for a harder-to-miss live callout indicator. Follow-up to 3043.

subject: Saved filters reset to default after updates, silently
body: [From research interview 2 Sep, logged by Dispatch PM; draft D-09, high] Twice reverted after an update; watched the wrong list for about 15 minutes. Wants a warning. Related: 3044, 3064, 3072, 3134.

subject: Larger text on the status badge
body: [From research interview 2 Sep, logged by Dispatch PM; draft D-10] Cannot tell engaged from available at a glance. Related: 3013, 3142.

subject: Capability tag legend hard to find
body: [From research interview 2 Sep, logged by Dispatch PM; draft D-11, low] Legend is in a drawer off the responder detail panel. Related: 3037, 3087.

subject: Requisition priority field does nothing; plate waited 11 days
body: [From research interview 5 Sep, logged by Dispatch PM; draft D-12, high, Rook Supply] Cracked vest plate waited 11 days for a quartermaster; priority field set but one queue for everything. Related: 3021, 3063, 3074, 3128.

subject: Field failure reports get no response
body: [From research interview 5 Sep, logged by Dispatch PM; draft D-13, Rook Supply] Reports appear on the item history but nobody follows up. Related: 3032, 3101.

subject: Equipment catalog search; add category filters
body: [From research interview 5 Sep, logged by Dispatch PM; draft D-14, Rook Supply] Searching plate returned about 40 results, half unrelated. Related: 3001, 3095.
